title: Good app👍🏻
body: Easy to use, but I would hope that the application could divide/compartment tasks into different categories, e.g. work/school, free time. Somehow then it would be more natural to write down for yourself what needs to be done for what and you would remember it better. otherwise this is a great app and I use it almost every day. :)

title: In-app purchases
body: Annoying because you have to pay to get more spots for habits and recurring events. This is supposed to be all health app and help you get through life, but then asks you to buy stuff when only 2 spots are taken??? Doesn’t seem fair. Health apps should be free and if you don’t get money any otherwise than that, then you could maybe make a donation option and I’m sure people would donate thinking this app is for increasing people’s health and not for money.
author: Atlessia
